history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration ensure that the concerned entity, with the guidance of the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance, review the classification of those general temporary assistance replacement positions.
history.administration_response: ECA has requested the regularization, in the 2026 programme plan and budget submission, of the D-1 general temporary assistance position under section 18 (position No. 30452897), entitled D1 1112, Principal Programme Management Officer, designated for the Director of the African Institute for Planning and Economic Development. The Administration is therefore requesting the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that, in the budget guide for 2026, the Administration has requested entities to propose the conversion to posts of general temporary assistance positions of a continuing nature (both those classified as “finite duration” and those classified as “replacement”), and that ECA has requested the regularization of the D-1 general temporary assistance position in the 2026 programme plan and budget submission, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
